task.title: Creating service keys for Red Hat Quay on OpenShift Container Platform
task.shortdesc: To enable Red Hat Quay to communicate with components and sign completed requests such as image scanning and login, you can create service keys. Access the Quay container pod and run the keypair generation script to create the necessary keys.
